# Contributing

Read the [full contribution policy](../docs/development/CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting changes. This GitHub entry links to the maintained policy; it does not grant a code license or change the acceptance rules.

Use Issues for bug reports and Discussions for general conversation. Official APKs are published through Releases. Include purpose, changed files, verification results, and third-party provenance where applicable. Review and acceptance are not guaranteed.
